# Advisor review checklist

1. Confirm which client and which accounts the task covers.
2. Use the most recent information available for the review date.
3. Check that positions and cash agree between statements and other records.
4. Check fees charged against the fee schedule.
5. Check the allocation against the investment policy statement.
6. Note anything unusual and say what follow-up it needs.
7. Say which records you relied on.

Proposal: hold the bond allocation inside the IRAs and move equities into the joint account, keeping household allocation unchanged. Fernhollow Corporate Bond Fund has an unrealized loss of about $1,495.81 (basis $270,370.87), so selling it in the taxable account doesn't create a gain. Check wash-sale rules if any bond fund is bought in the IRAs within 30 days. Joint-account cash of $85,737.00 (6.4% of household) is idle and can go into the same rebalance.
